pages.title: Goal
pages.text:
**Goal:** find a wild pad-runner in the March, not on your void pad.\
You need a charged **Gate Drum**, **Gysahl**, and the **Chocobo Almanac**.\
Birds do not spawn on a skyblock island. There is no spawn-egg shortcut and no join gift. Walk the March.

pages.title: Find, tame, ride
pages.text: 1\. Charge a **Gate Drum** with Pulse, then empty-handed use it and walk through. Do not strike it like a Drumheart. Yellows graze the Steppe and Reed Fen. Snow Fields hide Wonderful grades. Ember Wastes keep Flame birds.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
2\. Pick **Gysahl** in the March (Reed Fen is densest). Craft extras into seeds and plant them on dirt or March soil at home.\
3\. Craft the **Chocobo Almanac** (book and a gysahl leaf) and right-click a bird to read it.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 4\. Tame a wild yellow with gysahl, then saddle it. Sprint dashes; ease off to recover stamina.

pages.title: Esther at the hub
pages.text:
After you have walked the March, **Esther** stands at Clowder Hall (`/clowder hub`). Mount a saddled bird and speak to her, or place a **Square Gate**.\
**Check:** you are on a saddled bird, or Esther is waiting at the hub.

pages.title: Farm and colour
pages.text:
**Goal:** train, mate, and paint colours without chasing dyes that do not exist.\
You need greens to train, nuts to mate, and the **Chocobo Almanac** to read the bird.\
1\. Train an adult on greens until it is sated on each kind. Gysahl is the only green in the wild; Krakka is two gysahl and bone meal.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
2\. Mate with nuts. Talent follows the nut. Colour follows the parents unless Carob or Zeio is involved.\
3\. **Carob** (Bilo at Whiskerwind, or Class A races): two Good-or-better Yellows hatch Green or Blue. Each parent needs 1 first-place race; 4 combined firsts make the colour certain.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: 4\. Green plus Blue hatch Black (a miss is White) — 2 firsts each, 9 combined for a sure roll. **Zeio** (Bilo, rare at Class S): Black plus a Wonderful Yellow hatch Gold — 3 firsts each, 12 combined.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
5\. There are no Pink or Red birds. The Fair stall does not sell those dyes. Purple is End; Flame is Ember Wastes; Gold flies.\
**Check:** the Almanac shows colour, grade, class, race wins and the last nut. Recipes stay in JEI.
